_comment: Phasor-FLIM imaging tool. AutoForm over PhasorImgViewModel: a Controls dock (file, frequency, min photons; actions in the toolbar), g/s/intensity map docks and a 2-D phasor density histogram. The detector-window selector lives in each map (channel combo); the Frames dock plays the raw per-frame intensity stack. The IRF reference is carried per-detector from the IRF & BG step. Phasor is computed for every detector window from step-0 Setup.

sections.label: TTTR file
sections.description: PTU/HT3 imaging file; CLSM markers auto-detected.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Minimum photons per pixel for a valid phasor.

sections.label: Frequency (MHz, -1=auto)
sections.description: Modulation frequency; -1 auto-derives from the TTTR header.

sections.title: Phasor cursors
sections.description: Cursors on the (g, s) plane. Draw an ellipse round a lifetime cluster, a polygon round one that is neither round nor elliptical, or several combined; ~ selects everything outside. The Selected dock shows the pixels they pick out.

sections.title: Selected
sections.description: Intensity of the pixels the phasor cursors select — the image, gated by lifetime.

sections.title: Phasor plot
sections.description: 2-D density of the per-pixel phasor cloud (g horizontal, s vertical) with the universal semicircle.

sections.title: Phasor plot movie
sections.description: Per-frame phasor density animated over acquisition frames (play/loop/stop + frame slider).
